   910:     C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR,
   911:     C_ENTITY_COUNT,
   912: } CEntityKind;
   913: 
   914: typedef struct CEntity CEntity;
   915: struct CEntity
   916: {
   917:     String8 name;
   918:     // Interned id of `name` (0 when the parse ran without a symbol table);
   919:     // the scope-lookup buckets and chains key on it.
   920:     u32 symbol;
   921:     CSourceLocation location;
   922:     CTypeId type;
   923:     CScopeId scope;
   924:     CEntityId next_in_scope;
   925:     CEntityId next_in_lookup;
   926:     CEntityId next_typedef_in_lookup;
   927:     CEntityId next_by_name;
   928:     u32 declaration_index;
   929:     u32 declaration_token_plus_one;
   930:     u32 declaration_token_start;
   931:     u32 declaration_token_count;
   932:     u32 alignment_start;
   933:     u32 alignment_count;
   934:     CEntityKind kind;
   935:     bool is_definition;
   936:     bool is_static_storage;
   937:     bool is_thread_local;
   938:     bool is_constexpr;
   939:     bool has_constant_value;
   940:     bool constant_is_negative;
   941:     bool has_cleanup;
   942:     bool cleanup_attribute_checked;
   943:     // Register storage on a local. Only the local declarator path records it,
   944:     // and only one reader needs it: an assembler label on a `register` local
   945:     // binds a machine register instead of renaming a symbol.
   946:     bool is_register;
   947:     u8 reserved[1];
   948:     CEntityId cleanup_function;
   949:     u32 cleanup_attribute_token;
   950:     u32 cleanup_attribute_end;
   951:     u64 constant_value;
   952: };
   953: 
   954: // One shadowed binding, restored when the scope that shadowed it closes.
   955: typedef struct CParseBindingUndo CParseBindingUndo;
   956: struct CParseBindingUndo
   957: {
   958:     u32 symbol;
   959:     CEntityId previous;
   960: };
   961: 
   962: typedef struct CScope CScope;
   963: struct CScope
   964: {
   965:     CScopeId parent;
   966:     CEntityId first_entity;
   967:     CEntityId last_entity;
   968:     u32 token_start;
   969:     u32 token_end;
   970:     u32 entity_count;
   971: };
   972: 
   973: typedef struct CIdentifierUse CIdentifierUse;
   974: struct CIdentifierUse
   975: {
   976:     u32 token_index;
   977:     CEntityId entity;
   978:     CScopeId scope;
   979: };
   980: 
   981: typedef enum CDeclarationKind
   982: {
   983:     C_DECLARATION_OBJECT,
   984:     C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION,
   985:     C_DECLARATION_TYPEDEF,
   986:     C_DECLARATION_TYPE,
   987:     C_DECLARATION_ASSEMBLY,
   988:     C_DECLARATION_COUNT,
   989: } CDeclarationKind;
   990: 
   991: typedef struct CDeclaration CDeclaration;
   992: struct CDeclaration
   993: {
   994:     String8 name;
   995:     CSourceLocation location;
   996:     u32 token_start;
   997:     u32 token_count;
   998:     // The one declarator this declaration owns out of a comma-separated list,
   999:     // initializer included and the separating ',' or ';' excluded. Zero count
  1000:     // means the declaration was not split and owns its whole token range;
  1001:     // token_start/token_count always span the declaration specifiers, which
  1002:     // every declarator of the list shares.
  1003:     u32 declarator_start;
  1004:     u32 declarator_count;
  1005:     u32 body_start;
  1006:     u32 body_token_count;
  1007:     u32 parameter_start;
  1008:     u32 parameter_count;
  1009:     u32 alignment_start;
  1010:     u32 alignment_count;
  1011:     CTypeId type;
  1012:     CTypeId base_type;
  1013:     CEntityId entity;
  1014:     CScopeId scope;
  1015:     CParserDeclaration* syntax_declaration;
  1016:     CDeclarationKind kind;
  1017:     bool is_definition;
  1018:     bool is_variadic;
  1019:     bool is_constexpr;
  1020:     // Set on the second and later declarators of a list: the specifiers were
  1021:     // already parsed for the first one, so base_type is supplied rather than
  1022:     // recomputed.
  1023:     bool is_declarator_continuation;
  1024: };
  1025: 
  1026: typedef struct CDeferredStaticAssert CDeferredStaticAssert;
  1027: struct CDeferredStaticAssert
  1028: {
  1029:     u32 token_start;
  1030:     u32 token_count;
  1031:     CScopeId scope;
  1032:     CSourceLocation location;
  1033: };
  1034: 
  1035: typedef enum CParserDeclarationKind
  1036: {
  1037:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_OBJECT,
  1038:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_FUNCTION,
  1039:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_TYPEDEF,
  1040:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_TYPE,
  1041:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_STATIC_ASSERT,
  1042:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_ASSEMBLY,
  1043:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_UNKNOWN,
  1044:     C_PARSER_DECLARATION_COUNT,
  1045: } CParserDeclarationKind;
  1046: 
  1047: typedef struct CParserExpression CParserExpression;
  1048: struct CParserExpression
  1049: {
  1050:     u32 token_start;
  1051:     u32 token_count;
  1052: };
  1053: 
  1054: // One _Static_assert statement of a function body, at any block depth: the
  1055: // statement's token range, a leading C23 attribute sequence included, listed
  1056: // in the order the body reads.  It is the only fact the syntax pass keeps
  1057: // about a body statement -- the semantic pass rebinds bodies from their
  1058: // tokens, and the _Static_assert checks, which run against the block scopes
  1059: // that binding creates, were the one consumer of the per-statement tree the
  1060: // pass used to build.
  1061: typedef struct CParserStaticAssert CParserStaticAssert;
  1062: struct CParserStaticAssert
  1063: {
  1064:     CParserStaticAssert* next;
